shape: A near miss for the essay layout: a history dissertation in markdown, in a humanities subject and with a reading list, but built on a questionnaire and interviews the person ran.
tests: Layout: research, never essay. Data the person collected always means research (decision 0028), whatever the subject. The hypothesis, the method and the results are kept, and no significance is claimed.

keyFacts.fact: 143 of 410 history undergraduates replied to the questionnaire.
87% had used Wikipedia for a university essay; 6% had cited it.
Weekly users rated its reliability 3.4 out of 5, against 2.6 for the rest.
The hypothesis (heavy users rate it as more reliable) was supported.
Those who replied chose to, and all were at one university.

forbidden.why: The material reports means and no significance test.
The material gives 143 of 410 and no response rate.
